fields.name: terms
fields.label: Terms
fields.default:
1. What changes

We have rewritten our terms in plain language and added a section on AI features. Nothing about who owns your recordings has changed: your interviews, transcripts and highlights belong to you.

2. AI features

Transcription, tag suggestions and summaries run on your workspace’s data only. We never use your recordings to train models shared with other customers.

3. Where your data lives

You choose a region when you create a workspace: the EU, the US or Canada. Recordings stay in that region, including backups.

4. Consent from participants

You are responsible for telling interview participants that they are being recorded. Fieldnote announces itself on every call and can send a consent note with each invite.

5. Ending your plan

If you cancel, you can export everything for 90 days. After that we delete your workspace and tell you when it is done.
